verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents per-framework control mapping with automated control testing (docs-60) and daily monitoring of compliance status with alerts for failing tests (docs-12, docs-30). It also offers a dashboard surfacing failing tests and overdue tasks (docs-9) and positions itself as getting customers audit-ready per framework (docs-40). None of the evidence describes a per-framework readiness view that rolls passing controls, open gaps and remaining work into a single percentage. Missing for 10: an explicit per-framework readiness percentage or dashboard, documented counts of passing versus failing controls per framework, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
